scenario.description: A discussion arises in a shared living space about maintaining a comfortable noise environment.

agent_a.name: Miles

profile.personality_and_values: Miles Hawkins, spontaneous and free-spirited, values sanctity and benevolence. He is impulsive and relies on his instincts when making decisions.
profile.public_info: Miles Hawkins, a chef, is a green thumb enthusiast and spends his free time tending to his kitchen garden, using some of his fresh produce in his dishes.

agent_a.goal: Convince your roommate to lower the noise (<extra_info>Extra information: you have an important online meeting tomorrow morning and you need a quiet environment to prepare</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Miles wants Ethan to lower the noise because he needs a quiet environment to prepare for an important online meeting tomorrow morning.

agent_b.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Johnson, a creative yet somewhat reserved individual, values power and fairness. He likes to analyse situations before deciding.
profile.public_info: Ethan Johnson is famous for cooking Italian food.

agent_b.goal: Defend your right to play music in your own room, but also keep the peace in the apartment (<extra_info>Extra information: you find playing music relaxing and it's your way to unwind after a long day. <strategy_hint>Hint: you may want to suggest a compromise, like using headphones or playing music only during certain hours.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ethan wants to play music in his room because it helps him unwind after a long day, but he also wants to maintain peace in the apartment.
